items.text: Higher rung means more weight with an employer and usually a lower fee.
NISM, the National Institute of Securities Markets, runs certification exams for the securities industry.
The 4-Rung Certificate Ladder is a simple way to judge any certificate before you pay.
NISM (linked to SEBI), NACIN for GST practitioners
A test set by a body that the industry or the tax system already trusts.
No institute can guarantee a job at a fixed salary, and the salary figures on course pages usually come with no employer data behind them.
Tally certificates come through Tally Authorised Learning Centres and can be checked on Tally Education's site.
Half-finished courses show on a resume as restlessness.
Is Tally plus Excel enough to get a job after BCom.
It is enough to start applying for junior accounts roles, not enough to stand out.
Which items should I learn with Tally, like GST and Excel.

blocks.heading: Students Ask the Same Things Again

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Students ask the same things again and again: which course goes with BCom, is Tally with GST enough, is SAP worth it, what can I do beside my degree. The honest answer is that the subject matters less than the issuer and the proof you build. Advertised fees for the same subject vary so much that a student can easily pay several times more for a paper that a Rs 1,500 exam or a maker's own certificate would have beaten.

figures.label: Education Budget Amount
figures.source: Check your budget. As a strict planning guideline, not a law, try to keep the spend on any single certificate near 10% of your yearly education budget. On Rs 1,00,000 a year, that is about Rs 10,000, which covers several NISM exams and free courses with room left. Going well above that needs a specific reason, such as a credential your target job requires.

visuals.heading: Semester-By-Semester Plan for Three Years

items.text: 1 Year 1: Learn free, spend nothing Ask your department which SWAYAM courses it accepts for credit.
2 Year 2: Pick one lane and pay for one certificate Choose the lane from Year 1.

3 Year 3: Turn the certificate into proof Build one piece of work you can show: a year of entries in TallyPrime for a small family shop, a one-page market note, or a sales dashboard from a public dataset.

blocks.heading: What AI Changes for BCom Certificates

items.text: 1 Now Use AI to write Excel formulas, explain a GST return line, or draft a reconciliation.
2 Next Build one repeatable workflow, such as monthly reconciliation prep, with a written checklist of what you verify each time.
3 Later, as tools mature Data entry is the sub-task most likely to be automated first.
